text: {"question":"Which combination of observational data used in the GPAge analysis produces the highest best‑fit value for the Hubble constant, and how does this value compare to the one obtained when the SH0ES distance‑ladder measurement is included?","reference_answer":"The GPAge analysis that includes SN+CMB+FAP+CC data alone yields the highest best‑fit H₀ (~70.8 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹). When the SH0ES measurement is added (SN+CMB+FAP+CC+SH0ES), the best‑fit H₀ rises further to about 70.8–70.9 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹, slightly higher than the value without SH0ES but still lower than the SH0ES‑only determination."}
